_meta.authority: NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Deterministic structuring of controlled current-state evidence; not a qualification decision and not an authorization. No facts are generated from absence.

operating_findings.statement: Existing clubs recognized by historical/goodwill affiliation must transition under a governed continuity policy, not as brand-new applicants.
Core affiliation steps run on email and spreadsheets; decisions and evidence live outside a governed store. This weakness must not be recreated.
Processor-vs-ledger and cross-system reconciliation is manual; the target must implement explicit reconciliation boundaries (SYS-003/SYS-008).
Reviewer assignment is ad hoc with no jurisdiction-aware routing; the target must route by PTSO/CC jurisdiction (aligns with House FND-024).
Migration off the incumbent registration provider is a high-risk data transition governed by data-export rights and a recorded cutover trigger.
PTSO provincial jurisdiction and external systems-of-record authority (Sideline, accreditation, accounting) must be preserved, not absorbed.
Individuals hold multiple concurrent roles; the target identity model must not collapse role multiplicity into a single coarse permission bucket.

operating_contradictions.statement: Master-data authority for clubs/participants is claimed by Curling Canada (target) but operationally held by the incumbent registration provider and partly mirrored in Curling I/O.

positions.assertion: Curling Canada is the intended master-data authority (V0-06).
The incumbent provider currently holds authoritative registration/membership data.

operating_contradictions.resolution: Resolved by transition policy: incumbent is authoritative only until a recorded cutover; not a target-state authority.

operating_contradictions.statement: Affiliation decisions are governed in intent but evidenced in email/shared files in practice.

positions.assertion: Decisions and evidence must be bound to a governed transition.
Decisions and evidence currently live in email and spreadsheets.

operating_contradictions.resolution: Target must wire governed evidence binding; current practice is not the desired target.
